description__en: A fish sells for its C$ per kg times its weight. The community wiki gives the C$ per kg and the average sell value for each fish; we kept the C$ per kg only for the 726 fish where C$ per kg times average weight matches the wiki's own average value (within 2%). We have not tested it in the game ourselves.

description__en: A fish carries at most one mutation, and each mutation multiplies the sell value by a fixed number (the wiki mutation tables). Appraising can swap the mutation.

description__en: Shiny and Sparkling are attributes, not mutations: each multiplies the sell value by 1.85 and they come on top of the one mutation (the wiki attributes table says attributes stack). We multiply them together; the wiki does not spell out the order.
